ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant white high-intensity field (approx. 85-90% of surface area) and a sharp, low-intensity black perimeter and spotting (approx. 10-15% of surface area).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous white central field bordered by a contiguous black band along the trailing edge. Small, discrete black pixel clusters are localized on the interior of the left lobe and proximal to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 135 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of roughly 1:10 relative to the total horizontal fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (5-10 pixel peaks) along the left lobe trailing edge; the right lobe trailing edge displays lower frequency, broader peaks with shallower valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave mathematical curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to convex curves at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of several small (approx. 3-8 pixel diameter) dark circular clusters on the mid-ventral surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, non-aligned vertical linear disruption with a distinct brownish-orange hue (approx. 60 pixels long) located on the mid-inner region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, irregular jagged indentation located at the distal extremity of the left lobe, suggesting previous physical trauma or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized brownish-orange pigment staining on the right fluke lobe, distinct from the primary grayscale intensity of the fluke surface.
